name: Scenario H: Client Onboarding Automation
description: Triggered when a HubSpot deal moves to Closed Won (env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON). Fetches deal + associated contact, marks the company as Active Client, appends the client to the Google Sheets ActiveClients tab (env.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID), sends a branded welcome email to the client via Resend, and posts an internal onboarding alert to Brian. A global error handler logs failures and alerts Brian via Resend. Timezone America/New_York.

hook.label: HubSpot Deal Stage Changed - Closed Won

metadata.label: HubSpot Webhook: deal.propertyChange -> Closed Won
metadata.note: Fires when a HubSpot deal's stage changes. Configure a HubSpot Workflow (or webhook subscription) to POST to this URL only when dealstage = env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON. Expected payload contains dealId. The downstream filter re-confirms the Closed Won stage from the authoritative deal fetch in module 2.
Step 1: GET full deal details from HubSpot. Returns dealname, amount, hs_deal_stage, pipeline.
Guard: only proceed if the authoritative deal stage equals env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON. Prevents processing of out-of-band or stale webhook payloads.
Step 2: GET contacts associated with the deal. The first associated contact id is used as the primary client contact.
Step 3: GET full contact details (email, firstname, lastname, phone, company) for the associated contact.
Resolves the associated company id (companyId) for the deal so it can be marked as an Active Client in the next step.
Step 4: PATCH the associated HubSpot company, setting hs_lead_status to env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_ACTIVE_CLIENT (Active Client).
Step 5: Append a row to the ActiveClients tab in env.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID. Columns: client_name, email, phone, hubspot_company_id, monthly_fee, start_date (America/New_York), status=Active.

Step 6: Send the branded welcome email to the client via Resend. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS (B2B email to the client, CWI branding is acceptable). Includes next steps and the Calendly kickoff link (env.CALENDLY_LINK).
Step 7: Send internal onboarding alert to brian@cwiai.net via Resend. FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS (internal alert). Subject summarizes name, tier (deal name), and monthly amount.

Step 8: Global error handler attached to all modules. On any failure it emails brian@cwiai.net via Resend (FROM env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS) with the deal/contact context, the failing module, the error message, the scenario run id, and an America/New_York timestamp for fast manual remediation.

hubspot.label: HubSpot CWI Account
hubspot.note: HubSpot Private App access token stored in env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN.

google_sheets.label: Google Sheets Connection
google_sheets.note: Service account or OAuth with write access to the ActiveClients spreadsheet (env.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID).

webhooks.name: HubSpot Deal Closed Won Webhook
webhooks.note: Create a HubSpot Workflow (deal-based) enrolled on dealstage = env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON, with a 'Send a webhook' action POSTing { "dealId": {{deal.hs_object_id}} } to this URL. Alternatively use a deal.propertyChange webhook subscription filtered to the Closed Won stage.

setupInstructions.step1_hubspot_webhook: Create a HubSpot deal-based Workflow that enrolls deals when Deal Stage becomes Closed Won (env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON). Add a 'Send a webhook' action (POST) to the Make webhook URL with a body containing dealId = {{deal.hs_object_id}}.
setupInstructions.step2_hubspot_scopes: Create a HubSpot Private App with scopes: crm.objects.deals.read, crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.companies.read, crm.objects.companies.write. Store the token in env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN.
setupInstructions.step3_stage_ids: Run GET https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/pipelines/deals to confirm the Closed Won stage id and set env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_WON. Set env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_ACTIVE_CLIENT to the internal value of the company hs_lead_status option representing 'Active Client'.
setupInstructions.step4_google_sheets: Connect a Google Sheets account with write access. The spreadsheet (env.ACTIVE_CLIENTS_SHEET_ID) must have an 'ActiveClients' tab with header row: client_name, email, phone, hubspot_company_id, monthly_fee, start_date, status.
setupInstructions.step5_resend: Set env.RESEND_API_KEY, env.RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS (client-facing verified sender for other scenarios), and env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS (verified sender used for the B2B welcome email and internal/error alerts). No SMTP connection required.
setupInstructions.step6_calendly: Set env.CALENDLY_LINK to the kickoff call scheduling link embedded in the welcome email.
setupInstructions.step7_testing: Move a test deal (with an associated contact and company) to Closed Won. Verify: company hs_lead_status updated, a new ActiveClients row appended, the client received the welcome email, and brian@cwiai.net received the onboarding alert.
